title: Every Crab Is Kevin
subject: a wife who names every crab in the tide pools Kevin
caption: California reggae in the West Coast roots and dub style. One-drop drums with the kick and rimshot on three and dub delay on the snare; an off-beat skank electric guitar with chorus on it; organ playing the bubble; a deep round melodic dub bass; a clean surf-rock guitar lead answering the chorus; a melodica line in the bridge. Warm, lazy and roomy, the bass forward, spring reverb on the snare. Male voice, a smooth laid-back tenor with stacked harmonies on the chorus, plain American accent. 78 BPM, A major. Happily married at low tide. No Jamaican patois, no dancehall riddim, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - skank guitar and organ bubble]

[Verse 1]
Low tide at Shell Beach, she's got her jeans rolled up
I've got the bucket and she's got her phone out
She lifts a rock real slow and a crab runs out sideways
And she says "hey Kevin" like they go way back

[Chorus]
Every crab is Kevin
Big one, small one, one with a missing claw
Eight years married and I never asked her why
I just carry the bucket, every crab is Kevin

[Verse 2]
There's a little girl beside us with a net and a question
"How do you know his name?" and my wife says "he told me"
Now the kid is calling every crab on the beach Kevin
Her dad looks over at me and I shrug, yeah, that's how it is

[Chorus]
Every crab is Kevin
Big one, small one, one with a missing claw
Eight years married and I never asked her why
Now there's two of them out there, and every crab is Kevin

[Bridge - melodica over dub bass]
Tide's back in by four
She tells the Kevins see you Sunday

[Outro - skank guitar, spring reverb tails]
Sand all over the floor mats
She named the car Kevin too
